notablePrerequisites: You control at least six Goblins.
description:
Cast Brightstone Ritual by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Reiterate with buyback by paying {4}{R}{R}, creating a copy of Brightstone Ritual and returning Reiterate to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Brightstone Ritual, adding at least six {R}.
Repeat from step 2.
